command: echo '=== PERSISTENCE CODEPATHS READONLY ==='; date -Is; hostname; echo '--- ENTITYOS VM UNIT ---'; sudo -n systemctl cat entityos-vm.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- EXACT CODE REFERENCES ---'; for f in /var/lib/entityos/voice/buehne.py /var/lib/entityos/voice/erleben.py /var/lib/entityos/voice/wissen.py; do echo "[$f]"; sudo -n grep -nE 'consciousness\.db|world_experience\.db|amygdala\.db|FRANKENSTEIN_INNENWELT_DB|expanduser' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '--- EXACT DB TABLE NAMES ---'; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db; do echo "[$p]"; sudo -n sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name;" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '=== END ==='; exit 0
